__path.description: Workspace-relative path of the artifact file, injected by the orchestration harness (not authored in frontmatter).

__kind.description: Artifact-kind discriminator injected by the harness; must equal x-artifact.kind.

__artifact_id.description: Stable artifact id injected by the harness, derived from the file and frontmatter.

__frontmatter_present.description: Harness assertion that YAML frontmatter was found and parsed; always true for a valid artifact.

__sections.description: Artifact body sections keyed by their `## ` heading — one property per template section; the value is the raw Markdown under that heading. Authored artifacts may add or omit sections, so this is advisory (additionalProperties is permitted) and no section is individually required.

User-facing intent.description: As a <persona>, I want <thin slice>, so that <benefit>.

Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then).description: Use one flat bullet per criterion, labeled `AC1`, `AC2`, `AC3`

Routing classification.description: Risk: low | medium | critical — consequence of being wrong.

Work-item relations.description: Use only relations that help the team decide DoR, execution order, or slice boundaries.

Open items.description: The human-readable companion to the `open_items:` frontmatter ledger (the [open-item ledger](../../orchestrator/SKILL.md#open-item-ledger)) — this Story's **clarifications** (proactive unknowns surfaced by the CE Discovery turn) and **challenges** (reactive findings from peer review), forma...

Definition of Done (DoD).description: [ ] Code merged behind Central Supervisor approval (★ PR Gate)

__body.description: Raw Markdown body of the artifact (everything after the frontmatter), injected by the harness.

id.description: Stable artifact identifier (matches the filename stem).

status.description: backlog | ready | in-progress | in-review | in-qa | awaiting-pr | done | blocked

work_item_relations.description: Typed work-item relations (depends_on / enables / related_to / supersedes).

wsjf.description: Weighted Shortest Job First scoring block.

risk.description: low | medium | critical; set by PO before leaving backlog

complexity.description: simple | involved | complex; set by PO before leaving backlog

open_items.description: clarification + challenge ledger — see orchestrator "Open-item ledger". Each entry: { id, kind, raised_by, owner, blocking, status, … }; kind: clarification | challenge. status: open | resolved | withdrawn. A blocking+open entry HALTS the ★ Story Gate (DoR).

cost.description: token cost accounting — see the cost-snapshot invariant instructions

github.description: filled by portfolio/_sync (GitHub Projects board sync); null when authoring

parent_feature.description: Parent Feature id this Story realizes.

sprint.description: Iteration/sprint number this artifact is associated with.

pi.description: Program Increment number this artifact is associated with.

adrs.description: ADR ids the Story depends on

owner.description: Accountable owner role/hat for this artifact.
